calls.statement:
WITH e AS (
  SELECT e.*, m.member_id, m.marketing_consent, m.tier
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
  WHERE e.campaign_id = 19
)
SELECT count(*) AS rows_, count(DISTINCT exposure_id) AS dist_exp, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS dist_key, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS dist_member,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN delivered THEN member_id END) AS delivered_members,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19) THEN member_id END) AS in_holdout,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT marketing_consent THEN member_id END) AS no_consent,
  min(contact_ts_utc), max(contact_ts_utc),
  (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19) AS holdout_rows,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19) AS holdout_dist
FROM e

calls.statement:
WITH elig AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM dim_member
  WHERE marketing_consent AND DATE '2026-05-04' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to AND join_date <= DATE '2026-05-04'
),
tg AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=19),
ho AS (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM elig) AS eligible,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM tg) AS targeted,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM tg WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM elig)) AS targeted_not_elig,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM elig WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM tg) AND member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM ho)) AS elig_neither,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM ho WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM elig)) AS ho_not_elig,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_campaign_contact_load WHERE campaign_id=19) AS stg_rows

calls.statement:
WITH tg AS (SELECT e.campaign_id, count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS targeted, count(*) AS contacts FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key GROUP BY 1)
SELECT c.campaign_id, c.mailing_list_size - c.holdout_size AS expected, tg.targeted, tg.contacts, (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_holdout h WHERE h.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) AS ho_rows
FROM dim_campaign c LEFT JOIN tg USING (campaign_id) ORDER BY 1

WITH tg AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=19),
lines AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.sale_date, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, m.member_id, s.store_id, p.category,
         w.status, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM tg)
)
SELECT
 CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN 'web:'||coalesce(status,'nostatus') WHEN store_id=999 THEN 'training' ELSE 'store' END AS kind,
 category='ZZ Test' AS test_art,
 count(*) AS n,
 sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(dispatch_date, sale_date) BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' THEN net_amount END) AS net_by_eff_date,
 sum(CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' THEN net_amount END) AS net_by_sale_date
FROM lines GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id' AS chk, count(*)-count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS v FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-25' AND DATE '2026-05-31'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_receipt_line', count(*)-count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-25' AND DATE '2026-05-31'
UNION ALL SELECT 'max_sale_date', CAST(max(sale_date) - DATE '2000-01-01' AS BIGINT) FROM fact_sales_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'periods_not_loaded', count(*) FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE NOT fully_loaded AND period_start_date <= DATE '2026-05-24'
UNION ALL SELECT 'closed_stores_dates', count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE member_id IN (SELECT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) WHERE campaign_id=19) AND join_date > DATE '2026-05-24'
UNION ALL SELECT 'exposure_outside_window_helsinki', count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=19 AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', contact_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) NOT BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
UNION ALL SELECT 'exposure_channels', count(DISTINCT contact_channel) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=19

calls.statement:
WITH targeted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
  WHERE e.campaign_id = 19
),
web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
lines AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, m.member_id, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m  ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM targeted)
    AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
    AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
),
rets AS (
  SELECT sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=r.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM targeted) AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM targeted) AS members_contacted,
       sum(net_amount) AS net_before_returns, sum(gross_amount) AS gross_incl_vat,
       count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members_who_bought, (SELECT refunds FROM rets) AS refunds_net
FROM lines
